options.text: Unlike related phenomena, Friedel-Crafts Acylation is properly defined as: A benzene substituent that donates electron density to the aromatic ring by resonance or induction, accelerating the rate of subsequent EAS reactions.

options.label: D
options.text: Unlike related phenomena, Friedel-Crafts Acylation is properly defined as: A characteristic reaction of aromatic rings where an attacking electrophile (E⁺) replaces a ring hydrogen atom while regenerating aromaticity.

questions.correct_answer: Unlike related phenomena, Friedel-Crafts Acylation specifically denotes: The Lewis acid-catalyzed reaction of an aromatic ring with an acyl halide to produce an aryl ketone without carbocation rearrangements or polyalkylation.
questions.explanation: Concept discrimination: Friedel-Crafts Acylation is uniquely defined by: 'The Lewis acid-catalyzed reaction of an aromatic ring with an acyl halide to produce an aryl ketone without carbocation rearrangements or polyalkylation.'. The alternative statements erroneously attribute principles of 'Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution (EAS)', 'Arenium Ion (Sigma Complex)', or 'Activating Group' to 'Friedel-Crafts Acylation'.
